text: 1. Passport: Front page of the passport (with a validity period of more than 12 months). 2. Academic Certificate: Notarized certificate of the highest academic degree; if the applicant is a recent graduate, a projected graduation certificate or student status certificate from the school should be provided. 3. Transcript: Official transcript from the high school years (with the school's academic department seal). If the transcript is not in both Chinese and English, an English translation certified by a notary must be attached. 4. Language proficiency certificate: Provide a valid language test score certificate within the last two years (such as HSK, TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo). 5. Personal Statement: Motivation for academic and professional choices, more than 800 words (in Chinese or English). Click to download the personal statement template. 6. Recommendation Letters: Submit two recommendation letters from the teachers of the applicant's high school, and clearly state the relationship between the teachers and the applicant. 7. "Foreigner Physical Examination Form": Copy (Original should be kept by the applicant. This form is uniformly printed by the Chinese Health Quarantine Department and must be filled out in English). Applicants should conduct the examination strictly in accordance with the items required in the "Foreigner Physical Examination Form". Any missing items, those without a photo attached by the applicant or without a seam seal on the photo, or those without the signatures and stamps of a doctor and hospital are invalid. The validity period of the examination results is 6 months. Click to download the Foreigner Physical Examination Form 8. Certificate of No Criminal Record: Issued by the local public security authority. The document must be valid within the last 6 months prior to the application. 9. Financial proof: Provide financial guarantee materials (such as income certificates from parents or guardians, deposit certificates, or guarantee letters). 10. Other materials: Such as award certificates, proof of special skills, and other supplementary documents.
